android.desc:
Hubhopper is your free podcast creation and discovery platform in one all-in-one podcast platform. Create, host and distribute your podcast to global listening platforms and discover new podcast shows to tune into. 

New to podcasting? No problem, Hubhopper is the easiest way to create and distribute your podcast like a pro, letting you carry the podcasting world in your pocket. 

POWERFUL AND EASY PODCAST CREATION TOOLS 🎙: Record and edit your episodes anywhere. 
• Record, upload and crop your audio files 
• Add background scores & sound effects from our built-in audio library
• Visualize audio segments to arrange and merge into an episode
• Schedule episode releases
• Store episodes as drafts for future work

PODCAST HOSTING & DISTRIBUTION 🎧: Easy podcast management software
• Host unlimited podcasts
• Edit podcast description and details
• Generate RSS feed for your podcast
• One-click distribution to podcast listening platforms like Spotify, Apple Podcasts, JioSaavn, Gaana, Amazon Music, Wynk Music, TuneIn, and many more!
• Podcast distribution to OEMs and OTT platforms
• Store all your podcast links in one place 📲
• Podcast embedded player
• Podcast microsite tool
• AI transcription of episodes
• AI Show notes generation

DETAILED DATA ANALYTICS  📊: Get detailed data to track the performance of your podcast 
• Analyze podcast & episode performance
• Analyze podcast streams & listens
• Download analytical data
• Learn at what time, day & where are listeners tuning in to your podcasts
• Device data break-up 
• Listener location data
• Operating Systems data break-up 
• Podcast Platforms data break-up
• Add 3rd party data tracking prefix

PRO FEATURES FOR PODCASTERS: Get Pro & get more for your podcast for a low monthly cost
• Access to advanced data analytics
• Access to custom embedded players
• Add your website on your RSS feed
• Create Unlimited Private Podcasts
• Remove the watermark from the podcast cover art
• Host unlimited podcasts
• Unlimited episode scheduling
• Access to premium features & services
• Access to AI assistance with episode transcription & shownotes
• Publish more episodes
• Create and manage your team

PREMIUM PODCAST LISTENING EXPERIENCE🎙🎧 : Tune into a million hours of content from trending categories like horror, crime, education, technology, business, and news in 15+ languages including English, Hindi, Tamil, Telugu, Kannada, and more
• Create your own playlist. Make a playlist
